title: Songify Remake - Django & Spotify API
description:
This project is my own version (a remake) of a web application project I worked on at Fontys.
It lives on AWS and is implemented using Django, it also makes use of Spotify API to fetch categories and statistics with most popular songs of chosen artists.

title: Web Dashboard - ASML (and DP)
description:
While the title mentions relation to ASML, I have created a dashboard with the same site layout & tools I've used at ASML, but with my own idea.
Of course, the ASML dashboard solution had more features and personalized look.

Current version of this dashboard is just a concept - it is being worked on!
